images.name: 01-ho-so
images.label: Hồ sơ
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset: ONE full-screen landscape 16:9 game menu prototype, native composition 1672x941. This is original Vietnamese school journalism / social-life game HỒI ÂM, not an office dashboard. High-fidelity layout review; minimal text, strong visual hierarchy, clear controls.
Visual identity: ocean ink navy #102D42 dominates, rich teal #087F8C, turquoise #62D6D0, warm paper #F4F1E7 as local reading surfaces, sunlight yellow #F6C968 ONLY on current focus and primary action. Premium anime narrative-game art, sunlit Vietnamese coastal harbor and newsroom, translucent tide shapes and fine editorial rules; elegant large serif headings and crisp Vietnamese-capable sans body type. Keep dark blue space, avoid a giant beige dashboard. Original wave/quotation insignia. Restrained screen-print grain, layered folio edges, small attached white/yellow flowers and notebook/newspaper at bottom left, engraved harbor illustration along footer. Decorative elements must not obstruct content.
Shared shell: left 21% is a dark navy vertical navigation rail, small HỒI ÂM wordmark and wave mark at top. Exactly SIX icon+text navigation rows in this order and spelling: "Hồ sơ", "Kỹ năng", "Trang bị", "Đồng đội", "Bản đồ", "Cài đặt". Consistent simple ivory icons: file, branching skill nodes, shirt, people, folded map, gear. Selected row has a single yellow brush-paper strip, other rows ivory on navy. Bottom left under a thin rule: "THỨ NĂM · CHIỀU", lightning icon and "7/10". The remaining 79% is the screen's content region. Slim wave/paper footer with control hints "Enter · Chọn" and "Esc · Trở lại". Keep all readable content horizontal and sharply aligned. No redundant menu labels, no slogans or explanatory annotations, no paragraphs outside the specified copy, no browser/device frame.
Gameplay constraints: current energy cap is 10, no separate CLB phase, no time-cost minute counters, no manual newsroom/publishing screen. All example stats/quest names are layout fixtures, not final balance. SHOW DON'T TELL: use portraits, icons, slot shapes, branches and short labels; detailed copy only for the focused element. Every output is one actual game screen, not a collage, not a diagram with annotation arrows.
Edit target Image 1 is the Hồ sơ screen of this same set. Preserve its exact left rail position, six menu rows, wordmark, icons, status, footer, type family, navy/teal/yellow palette and attached decorations. Change ONLY the active screen content and selected navigation row. "Hồ sơ" selected. Use a DOSSIER LIST AND FOCUSED DETAIL occupying the right 79%.
Heading "Hồ sơ". Small horizontal category tabs "Main", "Side", "General"; "Main" underlined yellow. Main quest list occupies left 35% of content with three simple slim file-title rows, no descriptions: "! Căn phòng số 3", "! Sân bóng bị khóa" selected yellow, "! Trang báo bị xé". Exclamation icon accompanies main quests only.
Right 65% is one generous warm-paper folio showing the selected quest. Large title "Sân bóng bị khóa". Below a one-sentence DESCRIPTION: "Tìm hiểu vì sao học sinh không được sử dụng sân bóng.". A small gate/football-field evidence photo occupies top-right of folio, not a giant portrait. Section "Đã diễn ra" contains only two short checked lines "Đã gặp đội bóng" and "Đã xem cổng sân". At bottom a distinct small yellow-edge hint strip labelled "Gợi ý" with "Gặp người quản lý sân.". That's ALL the detail copy: title, description, past progress, next hint. No action-step cost table, no writing/publication panel, no extra dashboard widgets. Keep the focused detail readable without overwhelming the minimal title list.
